text: Artificial intelligence is advancing at an incredible pace. While today's AI excels at specific tasks like language translation or playing chess, the next major milestone is Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), which could think, learn, and adapt across many different fields just like a human. Experts are divided on the timeline; some predict AGI within a few decades, while others believe it is further off. The potential benefits are vast, from curing diseases and solving climate change to transforming education. However, serious risks exist, such as job displacement, privacy loss, or even unintended harmful actions if the technology is poorly controlled. Ultimately, how we develop and govern AI will determine whether this powerful tool becomes our greatest ally or our biggest challenge.
